questions: If there are multiple ways to choose five cards that satisfy the full house condition, does the function need to consider all possibilities or just determine existence?
Should the function handle cases where there are more than three cards of the same integer (e.g., four or five of a kind) and still try to form a full house by selecting a subset?
Is the order of input values significant, or can they be processed in any order?
Does the full house require exactly three of one integer and two of another, or could it be three of one and two of another with additional cards of those integers present in the unused cards?
If the input contains duplicates beyond what is needed for a full house (e.g., three 1s, two 2s, and two 3s), is it still considered possible?
Should the output be case-sensitive (Yes/No) or could it be lowercase (yes/no)?
Is it allowed to have the two-card integer y appear more than twice in the chosen five cards, as long as there are exactly three of x?
If the input contains exactly five cards that form a full house but the other two cards are also of x or y, does that affect the possibility?
